title: TAS Guard onchain (EVM) config v1
description: Config for `tas-guard rpc`: a local JSON-RPC proxy that an onchain agent uses as its RPC URL. Reads pass through to upstream_rpc; sends and signatures are decoded and checked against `onchain` first. Strings may use ${VAR} to read environment variables, so API keys can stay out of the file.

name.description: Guard name, used for daily usage and the audit log. Default: evm.

upstream_rpc.description: Your RPC provider URL, e.g. https://base-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/${ALCHEMY_API_KEY}. Never logged; only its host is shown.

upstream_headers.description: Extra headers for the upstream, e.g. an API key header.

listen.description: host:port to listen on. Default 127.0.0.1:8547. Keep it on loopback.

wallets.description: The agent's wallet address(es). Needed because the guard can't recover the sender of a signed transaction: raw transactions must match one of these by nonce, and eth_sendTransaction / signatures must come from one of these.

state_dir.description: Where usage, approvals and the audit log live. Default ~/.tas-guard (or TAS_GUARD_HOME).

approvals.description: Same as the MCP guard: terminal approvals with `tas-guard approve <id>`, and optional Telegram.

cli.description: false: only the phone can approve.

chains_allow.description: Chain ids. Empty = any chain. Others are blocked.

native_usd.description: USD price of the native token, as a number or { "<chainId>": price }. No price feed is queried.

tokens.description: Known tokens by contract address. Tokens not listed can't be priced (see unknown_value).

max_tx_usd.description: Hard: per transaction (and per allowance). Approval can't override it.

max_daily_usd.description: Hard: sum of USD sent today (local time).

approve_over_usd.description: Soft: above this a human approves.

recipients_allow.description: Known recipients of native and ERC-20 transfers. Your own wallets always count.

contracts_allow.description: Known contracts: the `to` of contract calls and the spenders of approvals.

token_approval.description: approve, increaseAllowance, ERC-2612 / DAI permits, Permit2.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 signatures that aren't recognized permits.

unsupported_methods.description: Other sending/signing methods the guard can't decode (eth_signTransaction, eth_sendUserOperation, wallet_sendCalls, personal_sendTransaction, ...).

preflight.description: eth_call + eth_estimateGas before forwarding a send; a revert blocks it.

approval_ttl_minutes.description: How long a held request waits for a human, and how long an approval stays usable.
